contract: User-authorized TradingView presentation extension: dark responsive /market plus dashboard chart, official ES module, NASDAQ:AAPL default, allow-symbol-change, interval1D. Real publisher reading is curated and dated; v2 APIs and synthetic simulation stay unchanged.

accessibility.evidence: Named Market/chart regions, provider loading/error live messages, 44px external links/retry controls, reduced-motion styling, and separate source/synthetic labels. Rendered text scan found zero host-page failures in18 checked combinations; closed TradingView internals are outside that scanner.

responsive.evidence: All six routes and widget fallback/remount states passed desktop/mobile no-overflow assertions. The actual provider emitted ready at1440x900 and390x844; measured chart hosts1052x612 and328x573.91 respectively. Screenshots inspected.

loading.evidence: Script registration without tv-widget-ready stayed loading; the20-second deadline produced an actionable fallback. Synthetic basket loading remained independent.

empty.evidence: Unchanged fresh-session/empty synthetic-practice states passed existing browser checks; curated publisher reading remained available.

error.evidence: Blocked ES module and tv-widget-error produced fixed safe messages, external link and reload/retry. Untrusted provider error details were not displayed.

partial.evidence: External chart still rendered independently when educational fixture data failed; real reading stayed visible if secondary synthetic practice failed. Source context/delay limits remained labeled.

success.evidence: 96 unit tests,26 Chromium checks, types/lint/build passed. Live widget emitted ready in both viewports; singleton SPA remount and source interaction preserved actual saved simulation/API snapshots.

permission.evidence: Browser-storage unavailability still displayed a safe error and prevented silent session creation; blocked external script displayed provider fallback without adding accounts or services.
